page.notes: Uncertain readings: "tæ[?]" after "Deo Jesu" is not clearly legible. "resituram" and "resituro" are read from a small, blurred type. The running head final word "Vocationi" is partly obscured. The printed "fatalliffimum" was read as "fatalissimum", and "Ꝺ" forms of long s were normalised to s. Printing errors left as printed: "Arminiam" (probably Arminiani), "Hoc fatum ... fatalissimum" as printed.
